analogy.rationale: TBXAS1 (thromboxane synthase) is a cytochrome P450 enzyme that converts prostaglandin H2 to thromboxane A2, but these cell lines are not platelets or vascular cells and express little TBXAS1, so thromboxane synthase inhibitors should produce minimal transcriptional response. The closest analogs are other eicosanoid-pathway modulators such as thromboxane receptor antagonists and cyclooxygenase inhibitors, which also act on prostanoid signaling and are expected to be similarly weak in these cells.
